messages:
samir: hey team :wave: quick q — where should I keep my ramp notes vs official docs? I'm copying snippets into Notion and not sure if they should go in /Company Handbook or my personal space. also how do I get edit access to team templates? thanks!
alex_devex: hey Samir — welcome! put personal stuff in your private "My Pages" (Notion personal workspace). Official docs and team templates live under Notion > Team Docs > Product > Onboarding. If you need edit access to templates ping @maria_docs.
maria_docs: @samir added. I can grant edit to the onboarding templates. Which template do you need? The "Engineer ramp checklist" or "Playbook clone"?
samir: engineer ramp checklist please. also do we have a recommended naming convention for personal ramp notes so they don't collide with public pages?
ben_pm: we usually prefix personal pages with "Ramp - <your-name>" and add tags like #ramp #private. For anything that's useful company-wide, file a PR on the doc and ping docs for review.
docbot: Deploy bot: Note: docs access changes require SSO group update. maria_docs will create a Notion invite within 24h.
maria_docs: invited you, Samir. You should see an email from Notion. If not, tell me and I'll check the SSO sync. Also attaching the template link: https://notion.so/r/engineer-ramp-template
samir: got it, thanks! :thumbsup:
